description: Test REST and GraphQL APIs with Playwright APIRequestContext, Supertest, or standalone HTTP clients. Covers schema validation with Zod 4/AJV, auth flow testing, CRUD lifecycle tests, error and header validation, pagination, and performance assertions. Use when: "API test," "endpoint test," "REST test," "GraphQL test," "schema validation," "Postman replacement." Not for: consumer-driven contract verification (Pact, broker) — use contract-testing; browser UI flows — use playwright-automation.
